signal: PandaDoc named Keith Rabkin CEO, acquired Denario, and launched AI-powered email drafts and data extraction in March 2026

email.body1:
Nora, saw PandaDoc named a new CEO, acquired Denario, and shipped AI-powered drafts and data extraction this spring.

Momentum like that usually drives more in-market SMB and commercial accounts than reps can cover, and that is where good-fit deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PandaDoc off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nora, quick follow-up for PandaDoc.

In SMB and commercial, the addressable base grows faster than your selling capacity can, especially after acquisitions and new launches. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your SMB and commercial segments need this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nora, last bit of proof for PandaDoc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PandaDoc's reply rate likely compares to other SMB SaaS firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nora, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling SMB and commercial pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. With a new CEO and recent launches, there is plenty competing for your attention.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an SMB and commercial motion? I will tailor it to PandaDoc either way.
